name: Ran of Hoa-Trinh
source:
A quiet girl with a brusque demeanor and perpetually deadpan expression. Her and Utsushikome have been friends since their first year of tertiary school in Oreskios. An avid reader, she is rarely seen without a novel (usually romance, despite her personality) and has a rich knowledge of history and literary culture, as well as a secondary hobby in photography. She prefers to keep to herself. While possessing little natural ability compared to her peers, she is highly diligent and carefully observant. With the right motivation, even a pawn can become a queen.

[From in-game encyclopedia]
